notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures to cast Vibrant Idea using convoke without paying mana.
description:
Cast Vibrant Idea using Hoarding Broodlord's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Landscape Painter.
When Landscape Painter enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
